description: Implementation of CartService for managing shopping cart operations in an e-commerce backend, including listing, adding, updating, deleting, and selecting cart items, with Redis integration.

classes.name: CartServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for cart operations, handling business logic and Redis interactions.

methods.name: cartList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of cart items for a user, including total price and quantity, with selection status.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a product to the user's cart, creating or updating the cart item in Redis.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the quantity and selection status of a specific cart item.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a product from the user's cart.

methods.name: deleteByOrder
methods.description: Deletes a product from the cart, used during order processing.

methods.name: setSelectedCondition
methods.description: Sets the selection status (all selected or unselected) for all cart items.

methods.name: sum
methods.description: Calculates the total quantity of items in the cart.

methods.name: cartUnitList
methods.description: Returns a list of Cart objects representing current cart items.

methods.name: deleteFromCart
methods.description: Helper method to delete a specific product from the cart in Redis.
